newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse up, buying pressure still high.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse up, buying pressure still high.

text.p: Strong demand, mostly from foreign investors, drove most Bucharest stocks to higher average and closing prices on Wednesday, in a rally which has driven the market since last week.
"There was plenty of foreign money in the market and there was buying pressure across the board," one trader said. "I'm leaving the session carrying unfulfilled buy notes."
Operators said signs the government supported foreign investment and political stability attracted overseas investors.

Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, climbed to fresh all-time highs, rising by six, 6.16 and 6.07 percent respectively from Tuesday.

Average price gainers led decliners 26 to six. Two stocks stayed flat, two were suspended and nine had no deal, a bourse closing report showed. The report also carried for the first time the price earnings ratio (PER) for each stock.
Volume grew to 3.9 million shares from 3.8 million and turnover added around three billion lei rising to 19.9 billion.
A special trade struck previously outside the market was also reported on Wednesday. It involved 103,757 Antibiotice pharmaceuticals shares traded at 10,000 lei each.
